q: Alat kuasa (power tools) ditakrifkan sebagai alat yang:
c: Memerlukan sumber tenaga lain selain tenaga manusia untuk bermula atau bekerja
e: Definition: hand tools – human energy; power tools – require other forces of energy to start, work or coordinate with work materials.

q: Pemegang (handle) alat tangan juga dikenali sebagai:
e: Parts of hand tools: 1 head; 2 handle (shaft/body).

q: Keperluan am semua alat termasuk penandaan yang jelas seperti:
c: Pengilang, model, kadaran dan kelas keselamatan
e: General requirements: protection against shock, mechanical, thermal, noise & vibration; strong construction; pass tests; clear markings (manufacturer, model, rating, safety class); safety instructions.

q: Arahan keselamatan yang perlu dibekalkan bersama alat termasuk:
c: Data bising dan getaran serta penggunaan PPE
e: General requirement 5: provide safety instructions (PPE use, handling, maintenance, noise/vibration data).

q: Keperluan khusus bagi gerudi dan gerudi hentaman termasuk:
c: Cuk yang kukuh dan tindakan menukul yang selamat
e: Particular requirements: drills – secure chuck, safe hammering; grinders – guard strength, auto shut-off; circular saws – blade guards, riving knife; reciprocating saws – strong blade clamp; routers – stable base, cutter guard.

q: Pengepit bilah yang kuat dan perlindungan tangan ialah keperluan khusus bagi:
e: Reciprocating saws: strong blade clamp, hand protection.

q: Tapak yang stabil dan pengadang pemotong ialah keperluan khusus bagi:
e: Routers/Trimmers: stable base, cutter guard.

q: Pengguna/majikan perlu menyimpan:
e: User/employer duties: inspect before use, replace damaged tools, provide training & PPE, keep servicing/inspection records.

q: Spana, playar dan tukul besi (sledge hammer) ialah contoh:
e: Examples of hand tools: knife, hammer, spanner, wrench, sledge hammer, screwdriver, saw, pliers.

q: Alat kuasa yang menggunakan cecair bertekanan dikategorikan sebagai alat kuasa:
e: Power tools by source: electric, pneumatic (compressed air), hydraulic (pressurised fluid), fuel, steam.

q: Pistol semburan (spray gun) dan stapler pneumatik ialah contoh:
e: Examples of portable power tools: pneumatic nailers, pneumatic stapler, circular saw, chain saw, spray gun, sander, grinder.

q: Seksyen 15(2)(b) OSHA berkaitan alat tangan dan alat kuasa menghendaki majikan memastikan:
c: Penggunaan, pengendalian, penyimpanan dan pengangkutan barang yang selamat
e: Section 15(2): (a) plant and systems of work; (b) safe use, handling, storage and transport; (c) information, instruction, training, supervision.

q: Mengetatkan atau menanggalkan skru, bolt atau nat menggunakan pemutar skru atau impact driver ialah aktiviti:
e: Activities: cutting & shaping, drilling & boring, grinding & polishing, fastening & loosening, cutting & shearing metal.

q: Menggunakan pita pengukur dan alat penanda sebelum memotong ialah aktiviti:
e: Measuring and marking: measuring tapes, squares, marking tools before cutting or drilling.

q: Bahagian atau kepala alat yang terpelanting ialah bahaya jenis:
e: Hazards: electric, cuts, entanglement, flying objects/equipment (parts, heads), lodged between equipment, vibration, hit by equipment, noise, dust/vapour.

q: Menyimpan alatan dengan cara yang tidak betul ialah:
e: Accident causing factors: wrong method, improper storage, improper maintenance, faulty tools, tools not suited to task.

q: Langkah kawalan alat tangan dan alat kuasa termasuk:
c: Mengikut prosedur pengendalian yang disyorkan pengilang
e: Control measures: suitable equipment, training, SOP, inspect before use, follow manufacturer procedures, maintenance schedule, storage area, sufficient tools, PPE, guards.

q: Faktor ergonomik dan kualiti bahan ialah kriteria dalam:
e: General design and fabrication: quality of material, ergonomic factors, suitable material, safety features (e.g. guards).

q: Pertuduhan kedua terhadap Family Products adalah kerana majikan gagal:
c: Memberitahu pejabat JKKP terdekat dengan serta-merta tentang kemalangan
e: Second charge: failed to immediately notify the nearest DOSH office of the 17 Nov 2023 accident causing serious injury – NADOPOD Reg. 5(1)(b)(aa).

q: Dalam kes kafe Tawau, jari mangsa termasuk ke bahagian pemotong mesin ketika dia:
c: Menekan daging ke bawah ke dalam mesin pengisar
e: Case study 2: 22-year-old putting meat into grinder for burger patties; pressing meat down when fingers went into the cutter; firemen cut open the grinder.
